messages:
molly: Heads up — I'm doing a small reorg of the Optimize toolkit examples (batching/caching/quant) and found a bunch of orphaned snippets. Will open a PR that moves samples into /examples/optkit and updates links in docs. Anyone owning samples?

sam: thanks, pls tag me. Which files?

molly: mainly docs/optimize/*examples.md and snippets under /snippets/optkit — e.g. the prefetch example and shortseq note. I'll paste the rough `mv` plan:

molly: ```bash
# move examples to new dir
git mv docs/optimize/batch-cache-quickstart.md examples/optkit/batch-cache-quickstart.md
git mv docs/optimize/kv-prefetch.md examples/optkit/kv-prefetch.md
```

tori: small ask — keep legacy URL redirects in place. Otherwise a bunch of inbound links will 404. Can we add redirects in nav.yaml? :eyes:

molly: yes, planning a redirects mapping file `docs/redirects/optkit.yml` in the PR.

daniel: also check snippets used by SDK README. CI flagged a broken link last night: https://ci.example/redwood/1234 — looks like the snippet path changed.

jen: pinging @sam — you maintain the js/sdk samples?

sam: I do. Happy to update import paths. If you rename files, pls add a test that ensures sample imports still compile: `scripts/check-samples.sh` covers py/js.

docs-bot: new PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/812 — 'optkit: sample reorg + redirect map' (molly)

molly: TY! @team please review tiny changes: link updates, redirect file, and one quant profile snippet that needed dtype fix. I'll keep commits small.

ci-bot: CI: docs/build succeeded, examples/unit-tests failed (2). See logs: https://ci.example/logs/812

sam: fixing unit test now, looks like one snippet used `int8` literal wrong — will push.

molly: ok, will wait for your fix then merge.

tori: optional: could we add a short TODO in the PR description to audit examples for short-seq heuristics? We should capture best-practice defaults. :memo:

molly: added TODO and a checklist in the PR body. Thanks! :rocket:
